checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with large tired face
must.why: Large man's face on right with dark circles, messy hair, blue phone light; 640x352 is about 16:9.

must.item: Headline of exactly three words, not placeholder
must.why: STOP SCROLLING. SLEEP. is three words.
Directly about stopping scrolling and sleeping.

must.item: High-contrast and readable at phone size
must.why: Big white and yellow text with black outline on dark background.

must.item: Face and headline unobstructed, not awkwardly cropped
must.why: Top of the head is slightly cropped at the top edge and the phone covers the chin area, but the face is clear and the text is fully visible.

faults.what: Low resolution (640px wide), below YouTube's recommended 1280x720.
Phone sits close to the face and the head is slightly cropped at the top edge.
The red eyes are subtle, not obviously red.

summary: A clean, punchy thumbnail with correct three-word headline and a large tired face lit blue by a phone, held back only by its low 640px resolution.
